resolution.question: Freelance translator Noor Haddad submitted a paid test piece to a subtitling agency that quoted a one-month turnaround. Will she hear back from them within that month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the subtitling agency actually sent a response (any form of communication) to Noor Haddad regarding the test piece before the one-month deadline from the submission date. The submission date is an unknown that the simulation can establish. Otherwise resolve NO at the deadline.
